description_en: Queries the running status of a pipeline node
description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点运行状态
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-status --pipeline-run-id flow-rbvg5wzljzjhc90000 --node-id node-kdkfkfds0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunNodeStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务的节点ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to N, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the N-1 layer is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询节点深度，当深度为N时，返回指定节点的N-1层子节点运行状态
parameters.name: depth

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:

Logical (default): the logical node. The nodes submitted by users are logical nodes.

Physical: the physical node on which a container is deployed for executing specific logic. A logical node is converted to a physical node when the logical node runs in the background
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值如下：
Logical（默认值）：表示逻辑节点，用户提交节点的都是逻辑节点。
Physical：表示物理节点，对应一个执行特定逻辑的容器的运行，逻辑节点在后台运行时会转换为物理节点
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id

Status.description_en: The statuses of the pipeline node
Status.description_zh: 工作流任务节点状态列表

FinishedAt.description_en: The time when the node finished running, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
FinishedAt.description_zh: 节点的结束运行时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the pipeline node

NodeName.description_en: The name of the pipeline node
NodeName.description_zh: 工作流任务的节点名字

RuntimeInfo.description_en: The runtime information of the node, in the escaped MAP format. You can customize the output of multiple KV pairs. If the same key value is used, the last output value is used. If the returned information is empty, {} is returned
RuntimeInfo.description_zh: 节点运行时信息，格式为转义后的Map，用户可以自定义输出多个KV对，相同的Key值会取最后输出的Value。当信息为空时，返回“{}”

StartedAt.description_en: The time when the node started to run, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
StartedAt.description_zh: 节点的开始运行时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

Status.description_en: The running status of the node

Status.title_en: 工作流任务的节点状态列表
Status.title_zh: 工作流任务的节点状态列表
